blocks.text: In the Zscaler Admin Console, the VDI Devices tab on the VDI Device Management page displays all the devices in your organization that have Zscaler Client Connector for VDI deployed.
Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) devices provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: View the VDI devices with Zscaler Client Connector for VDI installed.
Assess the VDI device status and details.

blocks.text: On the VDI Devices tab (Infrastructure > Client Connector > VDI Device Management > VDI Devices), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of all VDI devices. For each device, you can see:
Hostname: The name of the VDI device.
OS Type: The operating system (OS) of the VDI devices associated with the VDI group. Zscaler Client Connector for VDI uses the OS type that it detects to add the device to a group.
OS Version: The version of the OS associated with the VDI device.
Platform: The platform associated with the VDI device.
Modify the table and its columns.
Go to the VDI Groups page.
